The Kaduna State Government has appealed to religious and community leaders in Sabon Gari Local Government Area to support the All Progressives Congress in the 2027 general elections, citing its development projects in the area. The Secretary to the State Government, Dr AbdulKadir Meyere, made the appeal on Friday during a stakeholders’ engagement with traditional rulers, Islamic and Christian leaders, women, youths, and APC members in the local government. Meyere, who represented Governor Uba Sani, stated that the meetings were organised to strengthen the relationship between the government and critical stakeholders while seeking their support for the APC in the forthcoming polls. At a session with Islamic scholars, imams, and representatives of Jama’atu Izalatil Bid’ah Wa’iqamatis Sunnah, Fityanul Islam, Jama’atu Nasril Islam, and the Christian Association of Nigeria, the SSG acknowledged the contributions of religious leaders to peace, unity, and peaceful coexistence. He described them as vital partners in governance, urging them to use their influence to promote the administration’s development agenda. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Your prayers, counsel and support are very important to this administration,” Meyere said. He urged the clerics to encourage their congregations to back the APC and its candidates in the 2027 elections. The SSG noted that Sani’s administration has demonstrated its commitment to the development of Sabon Gari through projects in infrastructure, education, healthcare, and security. He also appealed to the religious leaders to forgive the government for any perceived shortcomings, insisting that the administration harbours good intentions towards the people. We appeal for your understanding and forgiveness. We are committed to doing more for the people,” he said. He further urged the clerics to intensify prayers for peace, improved security, and a successful electoral process across the country. Earlier, the Chairman of Sabon Gari Local Government, Sheikh Muhammad Albani, commended the state government for its developmental interventions. Albani noted that the engagement provided an opportunity for community leaders to interact directly with the government and offer input on issues affecting the area. In his remarks, the Madakin Zazzau, Alhaji Mannir Jafaru, urged residents to sustain peace, unity, and cooperation, while calling on the government to give continued attention to healthcare and other essential services. The District Head of Basawa also commended the government for projects aimed at improving residents’ welfare, expressing hope that ongoing interventions will be completed. Similarly, the Chairman of CAN in Sabon Gari, Associate Professor Adeyina Dele, prayed for peace and stability in the state. Dele expressed optimism about the continued development of Kaduna State and pledged to sustain prayers for the government and the nation. Godwin Isenyo
